marcado.f004: Do not tell me your name.
marcado.f008: You are in an unknown place.
marcado.f010: You do not know what it is.
marcado.p01.a.reacao.1: Interesting. You act before you think.
marcado.p01.a.reacao.2: You face what follows you. Few do.
marcado.p01.b.reacao.2: Calm. As if you already knew what was coming.
marcado.f011: It is never as simple as it seems.
marcado.p02.texto: What do you look for first?
marcado.p02.a.reacao.1: You read people before the place.
marcado.p02.b.reacao.1: You always know the way out.
marcado.p02.c.reacao.2: The wrong detail. You always find it.
marcado.f015: Someone you love is in danger.
marcado.f016: To save them, you will have to put other people at risk.
marcado.p03.a: I save the one I love.
marcado.p03.a.reacao.1: Loyalty. Even when it costs dearly.
marcado.p03.a.reacao.2: You choose one face and leave the rest in the dark.
marcado.p03.b.reacao.1: You refuse to accept the rules of the game.
marcado.p03.b.reacao.2: There is always another way out, is there not?
marcado.p03.c.reacao.2: Even if it costs the one you love?
marcado.f018: So that is what matters to you.
marcado.f019: You find a door that should never have been opened.
marcado.f020: On the other side lies an answer to everything you seek.
marcado.p04.c: First I try to find out who built the door.
marcado.f021: ...interesting. You would open it without a second thought.
marcado.f022: ...interesting. You would leave the answer locked.
marcado.f023: ...interesting. You want the name of whoever locked it.
marcado.f024: But that is for another time.
marcado.p05.c: I do not want to find out.
marcado.f027: You felt it, did you not? ...for now.
marcado.f029: When someone you love is about to die...
marcado.p06.texto: ...how far would you go to stop it?
marcado.p06.a.reacao.2: To the end. Have you decided this before?
marcado.p06.b.reacao.1: Practical. That is also a form of love.
marcado.p06.c: I would not sacrifice my humanity.
marcado.f030: But that is a matter for later.
marcado.f031: If you knew exactly the day you will die...
marcado.p07.c: Maybe it is better not to know.
marcado.f032: You want to know the end...
marcado.f034: You prefer to live without a countdown.
marcado.f035: The count runs all the same.
marcado.f037: Doubt is also a way of choosing.
marcado.f039: You can change one single thing in the world.
marcado.f040: You do not know what will happen afterwards.
marcado.p08.a.reacao.1: You like to play with things you do not understand.
marcado.p08.b.reacao.1: Prudent. Not everything needs to change.
marcado.p08.b.reacao.2: You fear what would come after.
marcado.p08.c: It depends on what I could change.
marcado.p08.c.reacao.2: Always wanting to know the price first.
marcado.f041: Let us leave that for later.
marcado.p09.a.reacao.1: Crowds. It is easy to get lost among so many faces.
marcado.p09.a.reacao.2: Too much noise. You learned to hear the silence between it.
marcado.p09.b: From the countryside, where everyone knows each other.
marcado.p09.b.reacao.2: Everyone knows each other. No one knows anyone.
marcado.p09.c: From a family whose weight I still carry.
marcado.p09.c.reacao.1: The weight of others is yours too.
marcado.p09.c.reacao.2: Some things are not left behind.
marcado.p09.d.reacao.2: You learned to obey. We shall see if you forget.
marcado.p09.e.reacao.1: Books say a lot. Never everything.
marcado.p09.e.reacao.2: Too many questions usually have bad answers.
marcado.p09.f: From places you only leave by surviving.
marcado.p09.f.reacao.2: You learned early the price of staying alive.
marcado.p09.g.reacao.1: Reserved. I respect that. For now.
marcado.p09.g.reacao.2: Not everything needs to be said.
marcado.f045: You can follow a known path.
marcado.f046: Or you can create your own.
marcado.p10.a.reacao.2: Those who follow the known path never get lost. Nor found.
marcado.p10.b.reacao.1: Proud. Paths of your own have no map.
marcado.p10.b.reacao.2: You do not yet know the price of that.
marcado.p10.c.reacao.2: Not knowing is also a beginning.
marcado.f057: You chose the one you loved.
marcado.f058: You refused the rules of the game.
marcado.f060: I looked for what exists behind your choices.
marcado.f062: ...was able to tell who you really are.
marcado.f063: Because you do not belong to the answers.
marcado.f065: The chains of reality were not made for you.
marcado.f069: You can make your own choices.
marcado.f074: And discover what you will do with this freedom.
marcado.titulo.3: You are free of the chains of reality.
